name: Togashi Riko
source:
Beautiful, cheerful, prim, and gentle... A Yamato Nadeshiko-type woman who is the epitome of a man's dream girl. Moreover, she's a good wife and wise mother, and excels at housework. 

She is diligent, just like her husband.

After graduating from university, she worked at a financing company, but resigned shortly after getting married. 

Her hobby as a whole is cooking, but sometimes she likes going to cafes and museums. She plays tennis, but only on a hobby level. Ever since she gave birth, she hasn't played much. 

Likes sex, but she can't and won't commit adultery. She won't cheat no matter who the partner is. Has experience masturbating, but doesn't do it habitually. 

Had sex with 3 other men before her marriage. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ190153.html]DLsite[/url]]
